canonical_project: Galaxy Backbone-Bauchi Hosted ICT/Data Centre Services Partnership
owner: Galaxy Backbone Limited / Bauchi State Government
notes: MoU covers digital infrastructure and ICT services across Bauchi State, leveraging Galaxy Backbone data centre facilities in Abuja and Kano. Sources do not confirm a new physical Bauchi data centre build, so this is recorded as a hosted/services partnership tied to the division.
